label: A4B7C2_hP39_153_2c_a3c_c-001
title: Trigonal Li$_{4}$P$_{2}$O$_{7}$ Structure
comments:
This is a metastable state prepared from the melt.  (Ragu\v{z}, 2019) also found a triclinic phase. 
 Space group $P3_{2}12$ \#153 is \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/ChiralSpaceGroups#ClassII}{chiral, Sohncke Class 2}, and so this structure should also appear in the enantiomorphic space group $P3_{1}12$ \#151, but we have not found any references to that structure in the literature.
